summary: Frontend-only deployment regression testing completed for managed config-freeze flow. Reproduced freeze/prebuild behavior in fresh scratch copies for both root and frontend projects with installed Stripe 0.64.0, validated no Apple Pay entitlement injection without merchant config, and confirmed scene/font retention with iOS prebuild artifacts.

react_native_issues.issue: Web preview still logs deprecated textShadow*/shadow* warnings; unrelated to iOS signing/config freeze scope.

Verify generated cloud archive/TestFlight install on physical iOS/iPadOS devices; Linux run cannot validate signed IPA or provisioning/capability resolution end-to-end.
If cloud signing still fails, compare cloud-generated entitlements against local prebuild output from this iteration before changing dependencies or credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: No Stripe native config plugin is present in root/frontend app.json; dependency presence alone did not execute entitlement injection in tested freeze/prebuild flow.
Existing older regression file still references fixed /tmp artifact paths; new portable freeze test avoids hardcoded artifact roots and should be preferred for future checks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 pytest passed + mobile web load smoke pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Resolved Stripe package evidence from installed node_modules: root path /app/node_modules/@stripe/stripe-react-native/package.json, frontend path /app/frontend/node_modules/@stripe/stripe-react-native/package.json, both version 0.64.0. Managed-freeze simulation in fresh scratch copies executed: expo config --type prebuild --json -> sanitized static app.json with overrides (name WANDERINGYACHT, slug wandering-yacht, version 1.0.1, ios.buildNumber 101 from version, projectId e2d8d630-a4ef-4de0-987b-11e96504aa5d), then introspect + expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install --clean. Generated entitlements stayed empty (no com.apple.developer.in-app-payments/merchant). Info.plist retained scene manifest and TraditionalArabic-Regular.ttf. This verifies generated projects only; remote signing/submission not tested.
rca_of_issue: Historical failure logs map to buildID a1134533-3fd6-4f32-a7df-a2cd4577abad (remote build104) before the source fix commit; they do not represent a post-fix retry. Regression confirms installed Stripe plugin function behavior: setApplePayEntitlement(undefined,{}) returns {}, while explicit merchant adds com.apple.developer.in-app-payments. Therefore dependency installation/autolink presence alone is insufficient to reintroduce merchant entitlement in this tested managed freeze path.
